title: Launch your Nokia pair from a Nokia
blurb: Pump.fun just added Nokia pairs. NOKPAD is a Nokia you launch them from.

parts.note: Cover image — goes in the cover slot at the very top, not in the body.

parts.html:
Pump.fun just added Nokia pairs. Coins can now trade against $NOK, the Nokia stock token.

A Nokia pair deserves a Nokia. So NOKPAD is one: a pixel phone you launch coins from.

Type it like a text

Open New coin and tap the name out on the keypad. Three taps on 2 for a C, like it's 2001.

Then the ticker and a line about it. Use your own photo, or the phone draws a pixel logo for you.

Pick who gets the fees

One switch before you send. Holder rewards on: the coin's fees go to its holders, paid in $NOK. Off: they go to you.

Your wallet signs and pays. The site never holds your money.

It rings when your coin moves

Every coin launched here is saved in Contacts, menu 2.

A new coin makes the phone buzz. Trades blip. When a coin migrates, the phone rings.

And yes, Snake works.

Connecting people. Now launching coins.

Try the phone at nokpad.fun. Launching switches on soon, so go type yours.
